name: FlashAttentionBwd

dout.description: output gradient tensor (B, S_q, n_heads, D)

dq.description: gradient w.r.t. q (B, S_q, n_heads, D)

dk.description: gradient w.r.t. k (B, S_k, n_kv_heads, D)

dv.description: gradient w.r.t. v (B, S_k, n_kv_heads, D)

reference:
import torch.nn as nn
import torch
import math
import torch.nn.functional as F

def _attention(q, k, v, causal, window_left, window_right, softcap):
    query_length = q.shape[-2]
    key_length = k.shape[-2]
    n_heads = q.shape[1]
    n_kv_heads = k.shape[1]
    head_dim = q.shape[-1]
    if n_heads % n_kv_heads != 0:
        raise ValueError('query heads must be divisible by KV heads')
    repeats = n_heads // n_kv_heads
    expanded_k = k.repeat_interleave(repeats, dim=1)
    expanded_v = v.repeat_interleave(repeats, dim=1)
    scores = torch.matmul(q, expanded_k.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(head_dim)
    if softcap > 0.0:
        scores = softcap * torch.tanh(scores / softcap)
    row = torch.arange(query_length, device=q.device).unsqueeze(1)
    column = torch.arange(key_length, device=q.device).unsqueeze(0)
    relative = column - (row + key_length - query_length)
    mask = torch.zeros((query_length, key_length), dtype=torch.bool, device=q.device)
    if causal:
        mask = mask | (relative > 0)
    if window_left >= 0:
        mask = mask | (relative < -window_left)
    if window_right >= 0:
        mask = mask | (relative > window_right)
    if causal or window_left >= 0 or window_right >= 0:
        scores = scores.masked_fill(mask.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0), float('-inf'))
    return torch.matmul(F.softmax(scores, dim=-1), expanded_v)

def run(dout, q, k, v, causal, window_left, window_right, softcap):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    q_float = q.float().detach().requires_grad_(True)
    k_float = k.float().detach().requires_grad_(True)
    v_float = v.float().detach().requires_grad_(True)
    output = _attention(
        q_float.transpose(1, 2),
        k_float.transpose(1, 2),
        v_float.transpose(1, 2),
        causal, window_left, window_right, softcap
    ).transpose(1, 2)
    dq, dk, dv = torch.autograd.grad(output, (q_float, k_float, v_float), grad_outputs=dout.float())
    return dq.to(dtype=q.dtype), dk.to(dtype=k.dtype), dv.to(dtype=v.dtype)
